sv.title: Kronprinsessan åker rutschkana – ”WIHOO”
sv.summary: Kronprinsessan Victoria har hela barnasinnet kvar. Hon kastade sig glatt utför en rutschbana – men prins Daniel var inte lika imponerad. – Wihoo, skrattade kronprinsessan.

en.title: The crown princess goes down a slide – ”WIHOO”
en.summary: Crown Princess Victoria still has the whole child's spirit. She threw herself cheerfully down a slide – but Prince Daniel was not as impressed. – Wihoo, laughed the crown princess.
